headline: A 2022 law labels methamphetamine an emerging drug threat and directs the White House drug policy office to create a response plan.
what_it_does: The law designates methamphetamine as an emerging drug threat, meaning a new and growing trend in the use of an illicit drug. It directs the Office of National Drug Control Policy to put a methamphetamine response plan into effect. The official summary does not list specific penalties, funding amounts, or new rules for individuals.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 14, 2022. The summary does not mention a separate effective date.
